quests.title: Dressed for the Long Rest
quests.text: Our shroud cupboard is nearly bare, and I refuse to enter 'wrapped in a sack' beside another name. Bring me two Glass Spider Silk from the Glass-Web Jungle Spiders in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways} at night, {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}. We may keep our dead for centuries; we can at least dress them properly.

quests.title: An Empty Space for the Date
quests.text: The register has a space for the end of every watch; I have left these entries open for far too long. Lay five Last Watchmen to rest on the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall} after dark, {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall}, and I can finally record their release.

quests.title: Bounty: An Island's Unfinished Dead
quests.text: The Crown Frost Strays on The Wyrmglass Crown have outlasted every record I can find of them. Get a boat from the Shipwright and sail across the channel to the island, then destroy eight in the {name:front_wyrmglass_crown/scree} at night, {zone_area:front_wyrmglass_crown/scree}. Return for your payment in coin; the bounty becomes available again one hour after turn-in. Do return in person, please, rather than as another entry.
